include numerical data in your answer.

Two ethical guidelines are debriefing and informed consent.
Suggest how ethical issues raised in the Piliavin et al. study (subway Samaritans) relate to these
two ethical guidelines.

with this training.

their session with the stooge they completed a questionnaire about their mood and their physical
condition.

weaknesses. At least one of your evaluation points must be about ethics.
